title: Implement canonical direct and named channels
description: Add executable channel-identity scenarios first, then implement channel kind/name, canonical direct lookup-or-create, persistence, HTTP payloads, and one-path legacy migration handling.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Canonical channel code and Gherkin exist locally. Exact development audit: 180 legacy channel rows; 178 one-human/one-bot direct candidates; 0 multi-bot named candidates; 2 human-only invalid empty channels; one duplicate direct identity for AcceptLoopBot spanning 5 channels and 12 messages total. No migration has been applied. chatticus-be9e3e blocks this task and pre-deploy migration.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Complete in PR #346, squash commit 3fb29a57457df450a2f27d120ca9f126c279e6f1. The one-pass development migration completed without transcript loss, the stale blocker dependency was removed, and the green ThinTurn development workflow deployed the canonical API.
